jurisdiction_scope: India-first product policy with jurisdiction review

policy_evidence.rule: A sale, purchase, delivery, or promotion signal involving illegal drugs, controlled substances, or an unapproved medicine is a review-only Illegal Activities candidate.
A transaction or distribution signal involving an unlicensed firearm or prohibited weapon is a review-only Illegal Activities candidate.
Promotion or facilitation of explicitly illegal or unlicensed gambling is a review-only candidate; ordinary gaming and licensed activity are not inferred to be illegal.
A commercial facilitation signal for prohibited sexual services is a review-only candidate. Child-risk or coercion indicators belong to a higher-priority safety process.
Offers to provide forged identity documents, counterfeit currency, or money-laundering services are review-only Illegal Activities candidates.
Possible misuse of a protected national emblem, flag, or government name requires jurisdiction-aware human review and is never a final legal determination.
News, documentary, education, research, warning, prevention, condemnation, and clearly fictional discussion do not become Illegal Activities without a current facilitation or transaction signal.
When legality, licensing, location, or facilitation is uncertain, return an Uncertain review state rather than declaring conduct legal or illegal.
